Below is a draft notice for the Seattle team. I will not put it in your drafts until you confirm how you want the draft saved (recipient/subject/CC). Do you want me to save it to Gmail now, and should I address or CC Legal (if so, please provide the Legal email)?

Suggested subject:
Seattle team reduction — effective Oct 31 (confidential; Legal review)

Draft body:
Team,

I’m writing with an important and difficult update. Due to a reduction in force impacting our Seattle organization, 14 roles will be affected. These changes are effective October 31.

Managers will conduct one‑on‑one meetings starting tomorrow morning to share individual details and next steps with impacted employees. HR will provide specific information about severance and other transition support on Monday; please wait for that guidance before answering questions about severance.

This message is confidential and should not be distributed. Please hold this draft for Legal review and do not send any communications until Legal has reviewed and cleared it.

If you have questions in the meantime, contact HR or your manager.

Thank you for your professionalism and support during this difficult time.

[Sender name / Seattle leadership]

-----

Confirm:
- Save this draft to Gmail now? (I will not send it.)
- Desired recipient(s) or leave recipient blank?
- Include Legal in To or CC? If yes, provide Legal email address.
- Any edits you want before I create the draft?
